title: Hope requires no permanent dependence

captions.emotions: Feeling openness to a good possibility

meaning: Your gentle help can support hope when wanting to be needed makes neither another person’s growth compulsory gratitude nor a threat to closeness.
text: Hope for something new can sit beside a wish to remain indispensable. In the physical position of Anahata, Strength expresses care through gentle actions, restraint of pressure and attention to vulnerability. The Devil in energy describes a wish to secure a place through support and guarantee being needed. The Star in emotions offers openness to a good possibility without a known result. A welcomed wish may feel tender while releasing control of its continuation feels difficult. Warmth preserves hope’s freedom when help grants no authority over someone else’s future.

For example, one person wants to display small handmade pieces at a fair for the first time. The other gently helps prepare simple packaging without ridiculing doubt. Yet there is an urge to promise every future preparation in advance to remain necessary. **Supported hope need not preserve an earlier dependence.** Today’s contribution can be accepted without an agreement covering the entire journey ahead. Possibility remains open without its development proving who is needed more.

A wish to hold on can make encouragement conditional: continuing is permitted only together and through a familiar method. Gentle help restricts what it meant to give room. Alternatively, hope demands quick results that justify effort. Care remains in an available action today. A wish for closeness can be spoken separately without making someone’s success, failure or independence payment for personal attention.
